title.en: Reward of Fasting and Seeking Forgiveness in the Month of Shaban

desc.en: Shaikh Sadooq (r) has narrated through his chain on the authority of Imam Reza (a) that: “The fast of the month of Shaban is the expiation of major sins even if the sin is of any unlawful murder. If a person fasts for some days in this month than I am hopeful of his forgiveness.” The narrator of the tradition ‘Ibrahim Ibn Maimoon’ says that I asked: ‘Which is the best supplication in this month?’ He (a) said: “Forgiveness, verily seeking forgiveness 70 times in this month is like seeking forgiveness for 70000 times in other months.” I (narrator) asked: ‘How to seek forgiveness and what to say?’ Imam (a) said: Say like this…

trans.en: I seek forgiveness of Allah, and, repentant, beseech Him.
trans.rurdu: Bakhshish chahta hu Allah se aur taubah ki taufiq maangta hu.
trans.urdu: بخشش چاہتا ہوں اﷲسے اور توبہ کی توفیق مانگتا ہوں۔

title.en: Reward of Fasting and Charity in the Month of Shaban

desc.en: Shaikh Sadooq (r) has narrated through his chain on the authority of Abbas ibn Hilal, “I heard Abul Hasan Ali ibn Moosa al-Reza (a) say, Whoever fasts on one of the days in the month of Shaban for the sake of Allah or repents 70 times on one of the days in the month of Shaban will be resurrected by Allah, Mighty and Majestic be He, along with the nation of Allah’s Prophet (s). He will deserve to receive an honor from Allah. Allah will forbid the Fire from touching the corpse of whoever gives some charity in the month of Shaban, even if it be as much as half of a date. Allah will record two consecutive months of fasting for whoever fasts for three days in the month of Shaban and continues on fasting with the month of Ramazan.

title.en: Supplication for Each Day in the Month of Shaban

desc.en: Rayyan ibn Salt reports that he had heard Abal Hasan Ali ibn Moosa al-Reza (a) say, The Almighty Allah will record security from the Fire and issue a permit to pass over the Bridge for whoever seeks Allah’s forgiveness by saying AS-TAGH-FERUL-LAAHA WA AS-ALO-HUT TAWBATA (I seek forgiveness of Allah, and repentant, beseech Him) 70 times on each day of the month of Shaban. And Almighty Allah will let him enter the Eternal Residence.

title.en: Namaz on Night of 15th of Shaban

desc.en: Hasan ibn Ali ibn Fazzaal, on the authority of his father quotes, I asked Ali ibn Moosa al-Reza (a) about the night of the middle of Shaban. The Imam (a) said, It is the night to get released from the Fire. On that night major sins will be forgiven. I said, Are there any additional prayers for that night? The Imam (a) said, It does not have any especial prayers. However, if you like to do a recommendable act on that night you can say the Namaz of Ja’far ibn Abi Talib and mention Allah - Mighty and Majestic be He -, ask for forgiveness and supplicate a lot. My father (a) said, ‘Supplications are accepted on that night. I said, The people say that that night is the night of Sekak. The Imam (a) said, That is the Night of Power (Qadr) in the month of Ramazan.

title.en: Ziyarat of Imam Hussain (a) on 15th Rajab and 15th Shaban

desc.en: Ahmed ibn Muhammad Abi Nasr Bazanti says: When I asked Imam Reza (a): In which month should we perform the Ziyarat of Imam Hussain (a)? He (a) replied: On fifteenth Rajab and fifteenth Shaban.

title.en: Supplication for the Last Days of the Month of Shaban

desc.en: Abdul Salam ibn Saaleh al-Harawi narrates, “I went to see Abil Hasan Ali ibn Moosa al-Reza (a) on the last Friday in the month of Shaban. Imam Reza (a) told me, ‘O Aba Salt! Most of the month of Shaban has passed. Now this is its last Friday. Perform the good deeds that you neglected to do during all this month in the few remaining days. I advise you to do what is beneficial for you, and abandon doing what is of no use for you. Increase the amount of supplications, asking for Allah (swt)’s forgiveness, reciting the Qur’an, making repentance to Allah (swt) for the sins you have committed so that Allah (swt) turns towards you in this month while you have been sincere with your Lord, the Honorable the Exalted. Do not let the responsibility for anything you have been entrusted with remain on your shoulders. Return them to their owners. Do not let any hate for any believers remain in your heart. Throw it away. Do not let any sins that you have committed remain. Get rid of them. Fear Allah (swt) and rely on Him regarding your private and public affairs.

arabic.text: وَمَنْ يَّتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى اللهِ فَهُوَ حَسْبُهٗٓط اِنَّ اللهَ بَالِغُ اَمْرِهٖط قَدْ جَعَلَ اللهُ لِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدْرًا۔

lines.rarabic: …WA MAIY YATAWAKKAL ’ALAL LAAHI FAHUWA HUSBUH; INNAL LAAHA BAALIGHU AMRIH; QAD JA’ALAL LAAHU LIKULLI SHAI’IN QADRAA.

trans.en: …and whoever trusts in Allah, He is sufficient for him; surely Allah attains His purpose; Allah indeed has appointed a measure for everything.
trans.rurdu: …aur jo Khuda par bharosa karega Khuda uske liye kaafi hai be-shak Khuda apne hukm ka pohchaane waala hai. Us ne har shai ke liye ek miqdaar mo’ayyan kar di hai.
trans.urdu: ۔۔۔اور جو خدا پر بھروسہ کرے گا خدا اس کے لئے کافی ہے بےشک خدا اپنے حکم کا پہنچانے والا ہے اس نے ہر شے کے لئے ایک مقدار معین کر دی ہے۔

desc.en: You should often say the following in the remaining days of this month, as Allah, the Blessed the Sublime, frees many people from the Fire during this month for the respect they hold for the month of Ramazan.

arabic.text: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنْ لَمْ تَكُنْ قَدْ غَفَرْتَ لَنَا فِيْ مَا مَضٰى‏ مِنْ شَعْبَانَ فَاغْفِرْ لَنَا فِيْمَا بَقِيَ مِنْهُ۔

lines.rarabic: ALLAAHUMMA IN LAM TAKUN QAD GHAFAR-TA LANAA FEE MAA MAZAA MIN SHA’BAA-NA FAGH-FIR LANA FEE-MAA BAQEYA MINHO.

trans.en: O Allah! If You have not forgiven us in the past days of Shaban, (please do) forgive us in the rest of it.
trans.rurdu: Khudaaya! Mahe Shaban ke guzre huwe dino mein agar meri maghferat nahin huwi ho, to baaqi ke dino mein meri maghferat farma.
trans.urdu: خدا یا! ماہ شعبان کے گزشتہ ایام میں اگر میری مغفرت نہیں ہوئی ہو تو بقیہ دنوں میں میری مغفرت فرما۔
